title: Hearty Buttery Ukrainian Bun Bao
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring a buttery, shattering bun, made with a lamination-puff pastry and served in a Korean brass bowl, perfect for a festive occasion.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, and softened butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large rectangle.
Spread the softened butter evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough into a triangle, then roll it out into a large circle.
Place the bun in a Korean brass bowl and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the bun from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
